claims.claim: Reviewers describe the progression and unlock system as an excessive grind, requiring hours of play or months to reach high-tier unlocks.

citations.review_text: Fun, until you get actually into the game and then microtransactions get blasted into your face every 5 seconds

if you are planning to play this game because you like btd6, you will not like this game. towers are nerfed and you need to grind for hours just to get tier 5s. some people will end up liking this game, but i couldn't imagine playing this game for more than a few hours.

I’ve put a fair few matches into Battles 2, and while the core Bloons formula is still cracking fun, this sequel feels a bit like it’s tripping over its own shoelaces.

gameplay is fast, frantic, and properly tense when you’re trading rushes with someone who knows what they’re doing. The tower variety is great, the visuals are sharp, and when a match goes well, it really does scratch that competitive itch

But the progression system? Absolutely glacial. Half the time it feels like you’re fighting the grind more than the enemy player. Some balance changes are spot-on, others leave you wondering whether the devs have actually played their own game. And matchmaking can throw you against players miles above your level, which is always a laugh — for them, anyway.

It’s not bad, just frustrating. There’s a good game buried under the layers of grind and imbalance, but it needs a proper tune up.

Final verdict: 6/10 — fun at its core, but held back by questionable progression and matchmaking
Loved these games, but they got greedy. 100% pay to win. you will be matched with players with unlocks that will take months to get if not years without spending money.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game suffers from crashing and connection syncing issues during online matches.

citations.review_text: The app crashes mid game no improve,ent

Game is way too grindy as a free-to-play player. In fact, without grinding, you are guaranteed to lose at the higher levels because you do not own any monkeys nor their tier 5 upgrades. No events where you earn extra monkey money either. In fact, there are no events. There are no patches, no bugfixes, no patch notes and buffs/nerfs beside maybe every quarter of a year. The devs forgot about this game. Period. Also, when playing bananza, the game just does not work. Send a FBAD past round 40, and you can literally kiss your game goodbye. I have upload/download speeds that are off the charts - I get kicked out, and lose the game. Fun, right? COmpetitive mode also sucks and is not based on skill, rather, it is based on how much you are willing to play the game. Clan wars/attacks are left out by the community and overlooked. There is no community, besides a couple of youtubers (a defend is a defend). Spent way too much time on this game, hoping it'd get better. Would also like to add that there are strategies (which the starting player is 50+ hours away from getting if F2P) that are literally unbeatable. E.G. S. Gwendolin on park (TS, GG, VL), Bonnie on Star (DG, SF, VL), etc. unless the player playing them makes an obscene error. This game could be great with a marketing campaign, balance changes, and virutally any help whatsoever to F2P players. I optimised money-making --- It's still impossible. Ninjakiwi, what you have done to Bloons TD battles is a complete disgrace. Uninstalled. Thank you.
Great concept, used to enjoy playing but the servers get buggier and buggier every time I play.

This game is fun to play for a while, but it's just riddled with so many problems. The biggest being the grind, grinding for monkey xp, and the cash to buy new heroes is just the biggest pain. It's unnccessary in my opinion and just drags the pacing of the game especially because certain heroes and certain upgrades can be the defining thing between winning and losing. Some of the maps are just meh to play on. Might just be me but it has a lot of syncing issues. I was playing with a friend of mine within the same room and we'd occasionally have moments where the game had to pause to connect again. Let alone online. 
This game also runs into the same problem btd6 does, that being lack of information. Unless you go out of your way to look up key stat information about monkeys and upgrade paths. You'll be at a severe disadvantage. I wanna say it's worth playing for a while, because it is. But you have to actually work for it, so.... idk. Unless you commit to this game, it's really frustrating and tedious getting into.
